name: xelta-remix-mcp

tools.name: rx_status
tools.description: The workspace root, whether a working ffmpeg and ffprobe were found, whether ffmpeg can draw captions (text_filter: the ass filter, libass), and each workspace (imported, analysed, proof complete); read-only. With slug: that workspace's probe, analysis counts, proof status, assets and latest renders. A missing ffmpeg is reported, not an error.

tools.name: rx_import
tools.description: Copy a local video (absolute path) or download a direct https media URL (500 MB cap) into workspace <slug>, byte for byte, and probe it: {probe: {width, height, fps {num, den, value}, frames, duration_s, has_audio, …}, sha256, bytes, reference}. Social-page links (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, …) are UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE: save the video and pass its path. Over 90 s is REFERENCE_TOO_LONG. A slug that holds a different reference is WORKSPACE_EXISTS unless overwrite: true (which deletes its analysis and proofs); the same file again is a no-op (already_imported). FFMPEG_UNAVAILABLE before any work without a working ffmpeg and ffprobe.

slug.description: Workspace name: lowercase letters, digits and '-', 1–63 characters.

source.description: Absolute path of a local video, or a direct https media URL.

overwrite.description: Replace a different reference already in this workspace (default false).

tools.name: rx_analyze
tools.description: Measure the imported reference with ffmpeg and build its every-frame pages. Writes analysis/analysis.json (cuts, flashes, audio hits, shots, per-second rates and energy) and sheets/page-NNN.jpg (36 frames each, 6×6, row-major, each page stamped with a proof code). Returns the counts, the cuts and flashes, and pages_total. Already analysed: returns the stored result unless reanalyze: true, which stamps new codes and voids every proof. WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND before rx_import; FFMPEG_FAILED with ffmpeg's stderr tail.

reanalyze.description: Run again even if analysed; new page codes, earlier proofs are voided.

cut_threshold.description: Scene score (0.05–1) that counts as a cut (default 0.3).

flash_delta.description: Luma rise (8-bit, 5–220) over the previous frame that starts a flash (default 40).

hit_rise_db.description: Loudness rise in dB (2–40) over the previous 200 ms that counts as a hit (default 8).

tools.name: rx_page
tools.description: See one page of the reference: an image of 36 consecutive frames (6×6 tiles, row-major: left to right, then down) with a 5-character proof code in the band at the top left, followed by a JSON summary {page, pages_total, frames [first, last], time_s [start, end], seconds, second_starts [{second, frame, tile}], proven}. Read the code from the image; it is never in the text. NOT_ANALYZED before rx_analyze. With of: "render": a page of the last checked render (rx_render_check), same layout, no code, nothing to prove; NOT_RENDERED before one.

of.description: Whose pages: the reference (default) or the last checked render.

tools.name: rx_proof
tools.description: Record that a page was viewed: its proof code (read from the rx_page image) and one note per second of the reference the page touches (the page's `seconds`) saying what happens in it: the shot, motion, text, beat. A wrong code is PROOF_MISMATCH; a missing, extra, duplicate or too-short (under 10 characters) note is INVALID_ARGS; neither records anything. Returns the proof status {pages_proven, pages_total, missing_pages, missing_seconds, complete}.

code.description: The 5-character code stamped on that page.

second.description: A second listed in the page's `seconds`.

note.description: What happens in that second, as seen on the page.

notes.description: One note for each second the page touches.

tools.name: rx_proof_status
tools.description: Read-only: whether every page of the reference has been viewed and proven, {pages_total, pages_proven, missing_pages, seconds_total, missing_seconds, complete}. The analysis counts as complete only when complete is true. NOT_ANALYZED before rx_analyze.

tools.name: rx_ledger_plan
tools.description: Register the remix's planned paid Xelta generations (each line with the quote it was priced at, from a quote_only reply) and one finite credit cap, in plan/ledger.json. Returns {lines, planned_max_credits (Σ max_credits × takes), cap}. INVALID_ARGS when the cap is below planned_max_credits or a line name repeats. Once a guard is issued the plan and cap are fixed (LEDGER_LOCKED); requote: true then only refreshes the quotes of unchanged lines. The bridge never fetches prices.

takes.description: Results wanted from this line (1–20, default 1).

max_credits.description: The quote's max_credits; this is what a guard reserves.

lines.description: Every paid generation the remix plans.

cap.description: Total credits this remix may spend. Required unless requote is true.

requote.description: Only refresh the quotes of already-planned lines (allowed after guards).

tools.name: rx_ledger_guard
tools.description: Must pass before every paid generate_image / generate_video call. Reserves the line's max_credits and returns {guard_id, reserved, model_id, settings, max_credits, attempt, totals}. Refuses ANALYSIS_INCOMPLETE until rx_proof_status is complete, QUOTE_STALE for a quote over 24 h old, CAP_EXCEEDED when spent + reserved + this max would pass the cap, GUARD_OPEN while the line has a guard with no job ID, ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED past takes (+ one re-roll per take for images, one retry for videos). A re-roll or retry passes reroll_of (the job it replaces) and a reason. Nothing is reserved when it refuses.

line.description: The planned line about to be paid for.

reroll_of.description: For a re-roll or retry: the job_id (or guard_id) it replaces.

reason.description: Why the replaced attempt is not used.

tools.name: rx_ledger_record
tools.description: Record what a guarded paid call did. {guard_id, job_id} binds the returned job (still reserved at max_credits); {guard_id, status: 'completed', charged} replaces the reservation with the actual charge; {guard_id, status: 'failed'} releases it (the attempt still counts). Returns {guard, totals {cap, spent, reserved, remaining}}. INVALID_ARGS for an unknown guard.

job_id.description: The job ID the paid call returned.

tools.name: rx_ledger_status
tools.description: Read-only: the remix's spend, {planned, cap, spent, reserved, remaining, lines [{line, attempts_used, attempts_max, rerolls_used, completed, open_guard, quote_stale, jobs}], resume}, where resume is a 'RESUME remix slug=… jobs=…' line listing every job ID recorded.

tools.name: rx_asset_add
tools.description: Bring one piece of media into workspace <slug>'s assets/ and record where it came from in assets/assets.json: {name, kind: video|image|audio, origin: generated|supplied|reference, file, sha256, probe, job_id?}. source is an absolute local path or a direct https media URL (rx_import's rules: social pages refused, 500 MB cap). origin 'generated' needs the job_id of a ledger guard recorded as completed, else NOT_IN_LEDGER (nothing is downloaded). origin 'reference' takes no source: it copies the imported reference (kind video, or audio to use its soundtrack). A name holding a different file is ASSET_EXISTS unless overwrite: true; the same file again is a no-op (already_added).

name.description: Asset name used by the EDL: 1–64 letters, digits, '_' or '-'.

kind.description: What the file is. Required except for origin 'reference' (default video).

origin.description: generated (a paid Xelta job), supplied (the user's file) or reference.

source.description: Absolute local path or direct https URL. Omit for origin 'reference'.

job_id.description: For origin 'generated': the job ID recorded completed in the ledger.

overwrite.description: Replace a different file under this name.

tools.name: rx_render
tools.description: Render a JSON edit list (EDL) of workspace <slug>'s assets with ffmpeg. preview: true writes render/preview.mp4 at 540×960, fast; otherwise render/master.mp4 (H.264 CRF 18, AAC) and the delivery file render/final.mp4 (H.264 High, yuv420p, AAC 192k, +faststart, ≤ 100 MB). The EDL is saved beside them. EDL: {width 1080, height 1920, fps 30, clips: [{asset, in_s, out_s, fit: cover|contain, camera?: {zoom_from, zoom_to, shake_px, shake_hz}}] placed back to back (a still lasts out_s − in_s), effects: [{type: flash|invert|black, at_s, frames}], text: [{text, at_s, end_s, font: Inter|League Gothic, size, color '#RRGGBB', x, y (output pixels), align: left|center|right, anim: none|fade|pop}], audio: [{asset, in_s, gain_db, fade_out_s}] (starts at 0, trimmed to the output)}. Camera moves act on the whole frame only. The whole EDL is validated first: INVALID_EDL lists every problem with its path (e.g. clips[2].out_s). Text needs ffmpeg's ass filter (libass), else TEXT_UNAVAILABLE. Returns duration, frames and the probe of each output. Then run rx_render_check.

preview.description: Fast 540×960 preview instead of the final.

tools.name: rx_render_check
tools.description: Measure the latest render (or render: preview|final) with the reference's own analysis passes and compare it second by second: {cuts, flashes (with frames), seconds: [{second, render {cuts, flashes, hits, energy}, reference {…}, ratio, weak}], weak_seconds (render energy below 50 % of the reference's), summary, pages_total}. Also lays every frame of the render out on pages (no proof codes): view them with rx_page { slug, page, of: "render" }. NOT_RENDERED before rx_render; NOT_ANALYZED before rx_analyze.

render.description: Which render to check (default: the latest).

tools.name: rx_get_skill
tools.description: Read the bundled Xelta remix skills (offline). Without args: the skill index. With name: that skill's SKILL.md. With name + reference: one of its reference files. Load 'xelta-rx-reference-analysis' before analysing a reference edit, and 'xelta-rx-spend-ledger' before any paid generation, and 'xelta-rx-assembly' before adding assets and rendering.

name.description: Skill name from the index, e.g. 'xelta-rx-reference-analysis'.

reference.description: A reference listed for that skill.
